article:
Test 7
For each question, choose the correct answer.
The Titan Arum
We usually expect flowers to have an attractive smell. However, this isn't true of all of them. The flowering plant called the Titan Arum only produces flowers every ten years or so — but when it does, the smell is so (21).................. that most people say they can't stand being near the flower, unless they hold their noses. They say that it's the worst smell they have ever (22)...................
The plant, which can grow to over 100 cm tall, is able to produce heat. As this happens, the bad smell is created. But the smell does have a purpose. It's intended to encourage all kinds of insects to travel (23).................. distances to visit the flowers.
The flowers always (24).................. a lot of attention because they are produced so (25). Scientists wanting to study the plant need to (26) out their research before the flowers disappear again for another ten years.

questions.explanation:
B. disgusting
解析：根据语境，泰坦魔芋的气味让大多数人无法忍受，“disgusting” 表示 “令人作呕的”，符合 “最难闻的气味” 的描述。
A. messy（凌乱的）与气味无关；C. frightening（令人恐惧的）和 D. painful（痛苦的）均不用于形容气味。
拓展：“disgusting” 近义词有 “repulsive”“nauseating”，常用于描述令人反感的气味或事物。

A. experienced
解析：“experienced” 表示 “经历、体验”，此处指 “他们曾经历过的最难闻的气味”，符合动宾搭配。
B. met（遇见）多接人或具体事物，不接 “气味”；C. realised（意识到）和 D. felt（感觉）与 “气味” 搭配不当，“feel” 更侧重触觉或情感感受。
拓展：“experience” 可接抽象名词（如 pain, joy）或具体经历，强调亲身感受。

D. long
解析：“long distances” 为固定搭配，意为 “长距离”，指昆虫被气味吸引而长途跋涉。
A. far（远的）通常作表语，如 “far away”，不作定语修饰 “distances”；B. broad（宽阔的）和 C. wide（宽广的）多形容面积，不用于 “距离”。
拓展：“distance” 常与 “long”“short” 搭配，“far” 多与 “from” 连用（如 far from here）。

D. attract
解析：“attract attention” 为固定短语，意为 “吸引注意力”，符合 “花朵因罕见而引人关注” 的语境。
A. aim（目标）需接 “at”；B. offer（提供）和 C. demand（要求）与 “attention” 搭配不当。
拓展：“attract” 的名词形式为 “attraction”，常见搭配还有 “attract visitors/customers”。

A. rarely
解析：“rarely” 表示 “很少、罕见地”，与前文 “每十年左右开花一次” 呼应，说明开花频率低。
B. slightly（轻微地）、C. hardly（几乎不）和 D. lately（最近）均不符合 “开花稀少” 的逻辑。
拓展：“rarely” 属于频率副词，同义表达有 “seldom”“infrequently”，反义词为 “frequently”。

C. carry
解析：“carry out” 为固定短语，意为 “执行、开展”，“carry out research” 表示 “开展研究”，符合 “科学家需在花期结束前进行研究” 的语境。
A. take（out）表示 “取出”；B. find（out）表示 “查明”；D. start（out）表示 “出发”，均不符合搭配。
拓展：“carry out” 后可接计划（plan）、任务（task）、实验（experiment）等，强调 “实施” 动作。
